card.name: Words just before 'your area' or locality
card.fires_on: Words right before a phrase meaning the reader's own locality, such as 'in your area', 'in your community' or 'locally'. It fires on the verb, preposition or 'your' that leads into it.

modes.label: Verb or preposition before 'your area'
modes.description: Fires on 'exist', 'in', 'available' or 'grown' when 'your area' or 'locally' is about to follow.
modes.example: You can visit a food forest for part of the day, but if one doesn’t<< exist>> in your area, get together with neighbors

modes.label: 'your' before a place noun
modes.description: Fires on 'your' when the next word is area, community or region.
modes.example: The agency listed will be able to put you in contact with the early intervention program in<< your>> community.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'where you are' or 'local', such as location, local, region and locality.
card.plain: It marks spots in the text where the next words will refer to the reader's own local area.
